**1.009: No dead ends, and steadier under load.**

- **Settings buttons are safe:** buttons that open a phone settings screen no longer close the app on phones that lack that screen; the app tells you instead.
- **Try it is never stuck:** with no model it offers Open Models, if loading fails it offers Try again, and "Set it up for every app" opens Setup.
- **Transcription Mode and full storage:** if the phone runs out of space mid-recording, the recording stops, is kept, and the app says why, instead of closing.
- **Models screen:** choosing or deleting a model no longer freezes the screen, and downloads redraw their progress less often.
- Discard and Retake no longer let a last piece of text slip in after them. Copy and Share say when there is nothing to copy yet, and TalkBack skips decorative images.
- Not yet tested on a phone. arm64-v8a only. Android 9+. Downloads: [hebrish.app/download](https://hebrish.app/download).
